summary: Frontend-only test of redesigned splash (/) and welcome (/welcome). All requirements verified successfully via Playwright on https://ai-food-logger-2.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844. Splash shows green #1D9E75 background with white wave animating upward from the bottom (partial at ~400-900ms, fully covered by ~2500ms), single static B logo image (beslence-b-logo.png, no emoji pop-ins) fades in & slides up, slogan appears below. After ~3500ms it auto-routes to /welcome. Welcome screen uses the same static logo (no AnimatedBLogo), all 6 required testIDs present with correct text, disclaimer contains 'tanı, tedavi veya sağlık tavsiyesi sunmaz', and 'Başlayalım' correctly navigates to /auth?next=onboarding.

verification_details.splash_wave_animation: Wave coverage observed ~25% at 400ms, ~75% at 900ms, 100% at ~2500ms (smooth cubic ease)
verification_details.splash-logo-image: present; img src=.../beslence-b-logo.png; opacity=1 at 2500ms (single static Image, no emoji animations)
verification_details.splash-slogan: present; text exactly '"Yediklerini, aktivitelerini ve günlük akışını tek yerden takip et."'; opacity animating in (0.82 at 2500ms)
verification_details.welcome-subtitle: 'BESLENCE AI ile yediklerini, aktivitelerini ve günlük akışını tek yerden takip et.' OK
verification_details.welcome-start-button: label 'Başlayalım' OK; clicking navigated to /auth?next=onboarding OK
verification_details.welcome-disclaimer: 'BESLENCE AI tanı, tedavi veya sağlık tavsiyesi sunmaz. Beslenme ve aktivite takibi için geliştirilmiş dijital bir asistandır.' (contains required phrase 'tanı, tedavi veya sağlık tavsiyesi sunmaz')
verification_details.no_emoji_animations: Confirmed visually – both splash and welcome use the single-piece static B logo image

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: index.tsx uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents` on Animated.View (console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'). Non-blocking but worth migrating to style.pointerEvents.
Minor: Some other screens (likely PrimaryButton or theme) trigger 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings. Not in scope of this review but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash + Welcome redesign verified end-to-end. Both screens use the static beslence-b-logo.png (no AnimatedBLogo). Auto-navigation timing is 3500ms. 'Başlayalım' routes to /auth?next=onboarding.
